description: Check a CSV against your explicit schema; return all issue counts and at most 200 detailed findings. Headers match exactly; required=false permits empty cells, not missing headers. Unique compares raw non-empty strings. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD, decimals use a dot without grouping, booleans use true/false. A valid=false report is a completed paid operation, not a tool failure. No values are changed; use clean_csv for explicit transformations. Validity covers only the supplied rules, not destination-system or business correctness.

choices.description: Optional exact allowed strings, checked before type conversion.
choices.title: Choices

maximum.description: Inclusive numeric bound, as a decimal string. Numeric columns only.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: Inclusive numeric bound, as a decimal string. Numeric columns only.
minimum.title: Minimum

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive header after any cleanup rename.
name.title: Name

required.description: Reject an empty value. Every declared header must exist regardless.
required.title: Required

unique.description: Require non-empty raw strings to be unique within this column.
unique.title: Unique

csv_text.description: CSV text including header. UTF-8, at most 1 MB; no file paths or URLs.
csv_text.title: Csv Text

request_id.description: Optional 8–128 character retry key. Reuse only for identical arguments; changed data requires a new key.
request_id.title: Request Id

title: Validate a CSV before importing it
